# Dragon Nails

> Nail salon based in Round Rock, Texas. A cozy, family-run nail salon on Chisholm Valley Dr. Manicures, gel, pedicures and detailed custom designs, made to your exact style and never rushed.

- Phone: (512) 218-8818
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Brushy Creek, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Pflugerville, Hutto
- Google rating: 5.0 from 87 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/dragon-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/dragon-nails/book.html

## Services
- Custom nail art: Ombre, glitter, charms, florals, holiday sets. Bring a picture or an idea and they'll build it with you.
- Manicures & shellac: Careful prep and clean cuticle work with a glossy shellac or regular polish finish.
- Pedicures: Relax in the massage chairs while your feet get cleaned up, shaped and polished. Regular, deluxe and gel pedicures.
- Acrylic, solar & Gel-X: Length and strength with solar pink and white, color acrylic or Gel-X, shaped and finished the way you want.
- Kids pedi-mani: Little ones are welcome. A gentle, fun manicure and pedicure with colors they pick.
- Facials & waxing: An hour-long facial, plus brow, lip, chin, full-face, underarm and leg waxing.

## About
Dragon Nails is a small nail salon at 412 Chisholm Valley Dr in Round Rock, run by Tina and her husband. Clients say it feels like visiting people you've known forever, and some have been coming to Tina for fifteen years or more. The salon is small on purpose. Reviewers say they take their time to get things right and put real care into customizing every set to your exact style, rather than rushing you through. Regulars mention Tina, Lily and Vincent by name, and say the team remembers them and what they get every visit. The salon is clean and quiet, without that strong acetone smell. Come in for a clean manicure, a relaxing pedicure, or a full custom set. Walk-ins are welcome. Bring the kids, bring friends, and bring your ideas.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. It's a small salon, so if you want a specific time, call ahead at (512) 218-8818.
- Q: Can you copy a design I found online?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo or describe what you want. Reviewers say customizing nails to your exact style and request is what sets Dragon Nails apart.
- Q: Do you do kids pedicures?
  A: Yes, the kids pedi-mani is on the menu. Bring them along with your own visit.
- Q: How do I pay, and where do I park?
  A: Credit cards and Apple Pay are accepted, and there's parking in the private lot right in front of the salon.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 7 PM and Sunday 12 to 5 PM, as listed on Google. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 412 Chisholm Valley Dr, Round Rock, TX 78681. Look for the red Dragon Nails sign.
